work.title: Le Tic-Toc-Choc, ou Les Maillotins
work.catalogue: Troisième Livre, XVIIIe Ordre, no. 6; Cauchie 278

version.note: Meyer’s exact edition and octave disposition are unidentified. Couperin’s preface authorises octave displacement for a single keyboard. The formal map groups the first two couplets with their returning refrains; its times are broad passage guideposts.

performers.note: The Commons file identifies Meyer; the discography places the work among her Les Discophiles Français piano recordings.

date.note: Commons supplies this range; the independent chronology gives 1953/1954. The same pianist also recorded the work in 1946, so the session range follows the attribution of this particular upload.

label.note: Historical label named in the source credit.
